concept: An abstract proof-bearing Web grows from the quiet geometry of a crescent eclipse. Fine filaments cross and bind into one intelligible woven seal, suggesting that a Cardano transaction carries every proof Strand it requires.
composition: Wide hero image, charcoal ground, with open dark space on the left for page copy and the emblem on the right. A restrained ivory crescent and thin antique-gold instrument circles frame a crisp lattice. Threads converge into a balanced central form; keep the linework legible at small size and the atmosphere quiet.
strands: Show many individually traceable filaments. Some pass through several intersections to imply that one proof can cover multiple conditions. The full weave travels as one transaction. Avoid any fixed Strand count, numbered paths, checklist, or required sequence.
brandConnection: Echo the existing Moriarty banner’s crescent, central star, circular guides, charcoal, ivory, and antique gold. Give the geometry the precision of a Victorian astronomical instrument without creating a separate logo.
avoid: No person, face, lettering, numbers, coins, padlocks, neon, generic blockchain node map, arbitrary three-Strand grouping, or seven-step motif. Avoid decorative threads disconnected from the Web.
imagePrompt: Wide editorial hero illustration: an abstract proof-bearing Web structured subtly around an eclipse crescent. On charcoal, fine ivory and antique-gold filaments form a precise lattice; several threads serve multiple intersections, all resolving into one clear central seal. Emblem right, open space left for copy. Echo Moriarty’s crescent, star, and measured instrument circles. Refined Victorian precision, calm negative space, crisp at small size. No text, human, literal sky scene, neon, node bubbles, or fixed thread count.
